message: Seeing connection saturation on order DB. Going to bump max idle timeout in staging to see if it stabilizes.
Drafted ConfigMap patch with the idle timeout update. Applying now via kubectl.
CRITICAL: order-service pod crash rate > 50% in production. PagerDuty incident #8821 triggered.
Wait, prod checkout is failing with 503s! What was just deployed? Who touched prod?

Hey team, order-service pods are throwing CrashLoopBackOff in prod. Wait... did I apply that hotfix ConfigMap to staging-us-east or prod-us-east? Checking my shell history... oh no, my kubectl context was pointing to prod-cluster!
Roll back the configmap immediately! Prod checkout is failing completely. Opening war room bridge.
Checking pod logs now: seeing 'ConfigurationError: required key DB_MAX_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS not found in configmap (found: DB_MAX_IDEL_TIMEOUT_MS)'. There is a typo in the key name in the ConfigMap!
Incident SEV-1 declared. War room active on Meet. Alex is primary remediator, Sarah is SRE lead.
Alex, do not edit directly in prod. Re-apply the previous configmap rev 42 from git. I will review your rollback PR.
Applied rollback HOTFIX-410 restoring revision 42. Triggering rolling restart of order-service pods.
RESOLVED: order-service 6/6 pods Running and healthy. Checkout API error rate back to 0.02%.
